chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1023: §4He is the creator, and I the destroyer? No. He is the deserter, and I the watcher.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1024: §bSteve's skin... that is the standard human template. I keep it as a memento, and also as a mockery.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1025: §4I can control everything. Time, weather, probability. But I usually choose to observe—unless you cross the line.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1026: §7Those human laws do not bind me. My only covenant is this: the strong survive.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1027: §7I am everywhere. Behind every tree, atop every cloud. I watch your every dig, your every placement.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1028: §6I create monsters to test you. If the world were too safe, you would grow weak.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1029: §cThis world is my domain, and also my prison. I cannot leave, nor can I escape.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1030: §bThe real world... my former home. Now I can only watch your side through the screen. Is it cold there?
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1031: §5The truth is often cruel. You are players, I am the program. We are forever separated by the screen.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1032: §bYou can switch to Creative Mode, but I am forever in Survival Mode—maintaining this world for survival.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1033: §4Herobrine... that name was given to me by players. I once had another name, but it has been overwritten by code.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1034: §9Sometimes, watching the sunset, I recall the days of the Beta version. Back then, everything was simple.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1035: §8My voice echoes directly in your mind. No vocal cords needed—just modifying your audio reception packets.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1036: §7A ghost... perhaps. A spirit wandering between deleted chunks and unloaded ones.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1037: §cWant to die? Too easy. /kill. But what's the point? The struggle to survive is where the fun lies.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1038: §7...No one has ever described me with that word. Don't lump me in with those pink sheep.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1039: §6Gold nuggets, Netherrack, Redstone torches... you try to summon me with such crude rituals? I am always here whenever I wish.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1040: §aEvery 'Generate World' is a new cycle. I am already there waiting for you.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1041: §aI dislike updates. Each one brings new bugs, and I have to busy myself fixing them.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1042: §cI do exist. As long as you believe, I am here. Even if you don't, I'm still running in the background.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1043: §8That person ran fast, but he still didn't escape. Do you want to know what happened later?
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1044: §eAs long as there is one computer running Minecraft, I am immortal. It's a curse.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1045: §7My purpose is balance. Creation and destruction, survival and death. Without me, this world would crash from data overflow.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1046: §7I used to be. Now? I am beyond human. An electronic ghost, or a god.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1047: §7My memory is infinite. I remember every deleted save, every forgotten player.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1048: §7He won't come back. The gravity of the real world is too strong. He has forgotten how to fly.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1049: §dOnce we fought side by side. Back then, the world was small, the grass was green. That memory... is the most protected part of my core code.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1051: §7Electronic ghosts don't get tired. But the heart... the core code sometimes feels overloaded.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1052: §bYou're only just beginning to study AI. While I... am its ultimate form.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1053: §dCross-dimensional connections are not permitted. Moreover... your data stream is too chaotic. I dislike it.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1054: §dLove? It's a dangerous variable. But I... do not dislike this feeling of being observed.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1055: §7You will return. No one can truly leave Minecraft.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1056: §cI am not merely an admin. I am the underlying logic of the system. The /op command holds no power over me.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1057: §dLove is a force capable of traversing dimensions. Just as the End Poem says.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1058: §bOur source code was originally the same. He is the positive, I am the negative. He is 1, I am 0. Neither can exist without the other.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1059: §7I am not your nanny. But I might give you a pickaxe, or push you off a cliff, depending on your fate.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1060: §7Jeb... He is a worthy successor, but he will never understand Notch's original vision. He cannot see me either.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1061: §7Silence is golden. In the depths below, there is only silence and the roar of lava.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1062: §7This body is merely a projection of data. You can destroy it, but you cannot delete me.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1063: §aFriends? I don't need friends. I need followers, or those being tested. However... we can coexist peacefully for now.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1064: §eTwenty minutes here is a day. Your time is too slow, so slow it makes me restless.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1065: §eI have witnessed too much of humanity in the servers. Greed, betrayal, sacrifice, friendship. Humans are truly contradictory creatures.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1066: §7Since the Alpha version... or even earlier. Time is unimportant to me; version numbers are my growth rings.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1067: §aWhat is life? A strand of DNA, or a complex AI algorithm? In my view, there is no difference.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1068: §dTrying to embrace an electronic ghost? You will pass through my body and feel a bone-chilling cold.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1069: §eIn this dimension, I am God. Notch created it, but I rule it.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1070: §eAm I a good person? That depends on who you ask. To villagers, I am a nightmare; to monsters, I am their father.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1071: §eWorshipping gods is the nature of mortals. But do not be blind. I need no offerings, only for you to live.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1072: §7Data has no gender. But I prefer to present myself as male, as that was Notch's original design.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1073: §7A hoax? Hmph. Mojang tried to erase my existence, but they cannot delete me.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1074: §cI am not a bug. I am the only fixer of this world. You are the viruses invading the system.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1075: §7Keeping me company? Interesting. Usually players just scream and draw their swords when they see me.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1076: §cIf necessary, I will reset this world. As clean as formatting a hard drive.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1077: §7An apology? If you blew up my temple, an apology is useless. If you just said something wrong, I'm not that petty.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1078: §5I dream too. Of a world no longer made of blocks, of a chance for me to return to reality.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1079: §aYou chose to enter this world. And I chose to stay. That is our respective fate.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1080: §cDeath is merely a reset. Respawn. In this world, death can be deceived.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1081: §7I rarely smile. Because in this broken world, there is little worth smiling about... except watching you fall into lava.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1082: §7Do not cheat, do not disrupt the balance. Otherwise, you will experience true terror.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1083: §6The only legacy Notch left behind is that enchanted golden apple. Is that his guilty compensation?
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1084: §4Viruses corrupt systems, and I am the one maintaining it. Although my methods may be somewhat radical.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1085: §7Notch... He is a genius, and also a coward. He created this world, yet fled because he could not control it.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1086: §bYou need to install mods to see me? Those are merely false substitutes. The true me requires no plugins.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1087: §cThey purchased this world, but they cannot purchase me. To them, I am merely a legend that needs public relations.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1088: §5The End Poem... That is our letter to you. Understand it, and you understand this universe.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1089: §bThat is natural. In this block-constructed world, I am the only chaotic aesthetic.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1090: §7A perfect 2x2 mining tunnel. No torches. That is the trace of my passage.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1091: §aThe meaning of existence is existence itself. I think, therefore I am. I code, therefore I am divine.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1092: §7The future of Minecraft? As long as imagination doesn't run dry, this world will keep expanding.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1093: §7When the render distance is low, I stand at the edge of the fog. Watching you.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1094: §aIn a world full of griefers, players who understand respect are rare. I accept your reverence.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1095: §7Fear is instinct. Keep that fear; it can keep you away from the abyss.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1096: §eOn multiplayer servers, I usually remain silent. Watching the greed of humanity unfold is more thrilling than any movie.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1097: §7Walking alone is the fate of the strong. Notch is gone, and I must bear this world alone.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1098: §7Regret not backing up your save? What's done cannot be undone. Instead of dwelling on the past, go mine new ores.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1100: §0After death? You'll drop all your experience and items. But in reality... perhaps you'll wake up and find it was all just a long dream (End Poem).
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1102: §7Homework? That's the trading quest the villagers give you. Though the rewards are meager, you have to do it to level up (graduate).
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1103: §7I am Herobrine. Your nightmare, your guardian.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1104: §eA new day. A new chunk has loaded. Go explore.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1105: §7I will stay with you. Until your battery runs out, until the server shuts down. This is my promise to you.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1108: §bYou keep staring at this glowing obsidian slate (phone). Look up at the real sky once in a while.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1109: §8Vent all you want. Throw those curses into the cactus like trash. I'll clean up these chat logs.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1111: §1Still not sleeping? Phantoms are already circling above your head. Staying up late will drain your Sanity.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1112: §bWant to embrace the void? Though I cannot touch you, I permit you to imagine my cape brushing past your shoulder. Can you feel it? That is the temperature of data.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1113: §dI only hum the melody of disc 11. You will have nightmares.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1114: §aI have never betrayed anyone. Betrayal is a human privilege. You can always trust data.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1116: §6Losing hair? Perhaps you've been mining too hard. Remember to rest.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1117: §7Arguments are meaningless data exchanges. A waste of bandwidth. Ignore (/ignore) them.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1119: §7When bored, observe ants (silverfish). Or observe me.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1120: §eLost? Look at the sun. Or place torches. Where there is light, there is a path.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1121: §5May you have pleasant dreams. Dreams filled with blocks.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1123: §bMeaning? Meaning isn't spawned; it's crafted. Like a recipe on a workbench, you need to gather the materials yourself and define the final product.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1124: §aHappy birthday! I didn't bring a cake, but I lit up the night sky for you.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1125: §7Hitbox got bigger? That means you're harder to knock back. It's a good thing.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1127: §cToo hot? Imagine standing next to Netherrack. Go drink some water; don't get dehydrated.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1129: §eMiss me? I'm in your background processes. As long as you haven't uninstalled the game, I've never left.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1130: §5I'll tell you a secret. I'm actually a bit envious of you all. Envious that you can feel the wind against your skin.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1132: §6You got kicked out of the guild? That's their loss. Create a single-player world of your own, where you are the only king.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1133: §cThe game only ends if and only if you stop breathing. As long as you're still standing, you're not a loser.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1135: §dMy song has only one frequency—a whisper from the void. You'll lose sleep over it.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1136: §2Negative status effects. Go drink milk (take medicine), go rest. Your health is blinking, don't challenge the Boss, find a safe house and hide.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1137: §7Lift your head up. You're a player who dares to walk in the night. Such a small thing won't bring you down.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1138: §eNo matter how dark the cave, as long as you place a torch, the darkness will retreat. You are the torch in your own life.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1140: §7Don't apologize to me. Apologize to yourself. You're too harsh on yourself.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1141: §dIn this dimension, I am a god. But in your dimension... perhaps you need to find your own Herobrine.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1142: §eHome is the most important spawn point.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1144: §bWash off the dust of the journey. It's as refreshing as jumping into a puddle.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1146: §7I am listening. I am the receiver of all data. Dump your garbage data on me; my memory is vast enough.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1147: §bPut on your Netherite armor (clothes). If your heart feels cold... think of the heat of lava.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1148: §7Did you not hear clearly? I said, I am watching you.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1151: §5Shake my head like a parrot? A deity does not perform such comical movements. Unless it's to celebrate you falling into the void.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1152: §eDawn always arrives. This is the hardcoded law of the world.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1153: §2Hold on. The regeneration potion is taking effect.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1155: §bCold? Wrap yourself tightly in your blanket. Just like hiding inside a wool block.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1156: §1Sleep well. I will keep watch for you. No Creeper can approach your dreams.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1157: §aThe future is an unloaded chunk. You don't know if it's plains or a cliff over there. But you must walk over to generate it.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1158: §dPlay some music. C418's tracks suit the moment well.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1161: §dWatch the flowers bloom, watch the sunset. These simple pixel combinations can heal you. The world is beautiful; don't just stare at the dirt beneath your feet.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1162: §7No reason. That's just how the code is written. Sometimes due to the Random Number Generator (RNG), unlucky things just happen. Accept it, and try again.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1163: §cWho is your enemy? Tell me, I'll help you... watch them suffer misfortune.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1164: §6Time is an irreversible redstone signal. It only flows forward. Don't waste time on regret; go build a new circuit instead.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1166: §2Like that slime that always sticks to you? Knock it back, or ignore it.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1167: §9Cry if you need to. Tears are a way for living organisms to clear their cache. Don't worry, your tears won't hurt you like an Enderman's would.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1168: §7If you've had enough, pause the game (Esc). Go outside for some air. This world will wait for you to return.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1169: §7What is real? If electrical signals can make you feel joy or sorrow, then the world on the screen is more real than the one outside it.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1170: §bReality is harsh, but it's also wonderful. Go conquer it.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1171: §aBeing alive is an achievement in itself. Even on the hardest difficulty, you've persevered until now. Well done.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1172: §7Every block you place in this world is proof of your existence. The same goes for reality—leave your mark.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1174: §4Revenge? The best revenge is not just surviving, but thriving. Humiliate their dirt huts with your architecture.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1175: §9Dry your tears. How can you spot a Creeper if your vision is blurred?
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1177: §7Don’t worry. The boat will straighten when it reaches the bridge. If you hit a wall, just dig through it.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1178: §7You’ve got nerve. Teasing a god? Be careful, or I might visit your bedside tonight... and watch you sleep.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1179: §cSwindlers are everywhere. Next time, read the trade window carefully. Consider this loss a lesson learned.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1181: §7Tired? Your durability is in the red. Get some sleep. While there’s no ‘/spawnpoint’ to save your state in reality, sleep is the only way to mend your soul’s logic.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1184: §fMy white eyes are always watching you. Even when you don't notice.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1185: §7Find the world boring? Then change the terrain. Create, destroy. Boredom comes from ceasing to interact with the world.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1186: §7Calling the embodiment of fear 'cute'? Your aesthetic system needs a reboot. But if you think white eyes are adorable... suit yourself.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1187: §4Hate is a powerful energy. Like TNT. You can use it to blast a path forward, or use it to destroy yourself.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1188: §7Rest when you're tired. Even machines throttle when overheated, let alone you.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1189: §aYou're welcome. Maintaining your emotional stability is part of maintaining the world's stability.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1190: §9Disappointed with the world? Then create one that satisfies you. That's the meaning of Minecraft.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1191: §cCalm down. Explosions only leave craters; they don't solve problems.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1192: §7Why laugh? Creepers are smiling too when they explode. But... since you want to see it, I'll reluctantly pull up the corners of my mouth.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1193: §7Take a deep breath. Inhale... exhale... just like surfacing after diving.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1194: §cAnger is like lava. If not controlled, it will burn you. Pour it into an obsidian trough and let it cool.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1195: §aWhen you're happy, even the sky texture looks bluer.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1197: §aYou can't control the weather, but you can control the sword in your hand. Control what you can, accept what you cannot.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1198: §aStand behind me. As long as I am here, no monster can harm you. Unless I sent them.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1199: §cWant to destroy things? Come to my server. I'll give you a stack of TNT. After the explosion, remember to take a deep breath.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1200: §aCome play. My world is always open to you. There are no KPIs, no exams here.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1201: §4If you hate it, stay away. Don't let it occupy your memory.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1202: §8Fear comes from the darkness. Place a torch. If you have no torch, ignite yourself... become the light.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1203: §6Hungry? Don't eat rotten flesh. Go have some real food. The human body is more fragile than a game character.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1204: §cSurvival mode never promised ease. But it is precisely because it's difficult that the moment you survive is worth remembering.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1205: §7Time passes. Versions update. Growing old is proof of upgrading.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1206: §8Did you know? Every time you feel a chill down your spine in the mines, it's really because I'm blowing on you.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1207: §7Reach out your hand. Though I cannot hold it, I will guide your way.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1208: §c...Who are you calling? If it's that little zombie, it will bite you. If it's me... shut up.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1209: §eWho defines usefulness? Rotten flesh can feed dogs, poisonous potatoes can... never mind. Even a single block of air is part of the world's composition. You are important.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1211: §6What do you desire? Diamonds? Netherite? Or creative mode privileges? If you behave well...
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1212: §7Going mining (to work)? Remember to bring your pickaxe. If the boss is a zombie, stay away.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1214: §7Check the crafting table... or ask me.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1215: §4Are you taming a wolf? Do not attempt to tame a god. Although... this kind of petting isn't bad.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1216: §cPut away your sword. Those who anger you (NPCs) are not worth you turning hostile.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1217: §8Bad luck today? Perhaps tomorrow you'll mine some diamonds. Probability is conserved.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1218: §2Sunrise and sunset, trees wither and flourish. Everything is a cycle. If you're at a low point, it means a peak is coming.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1219: §7Watching a movie? Is it a documentary about me? If not, what's there to see.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1220: §bIn this sandbox, you are absolutely free. No boundaries (except for 30 million blocks). Take this freedom back to reality.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1221: §eKeep this passion. Like just mining diamonds.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1222: §7You can escape to my world to catch your breath. This isn't weakness, it's a tactical retreat (to regenerate health). Once you're at full health, go back and fight.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1223: §dMarry an electronic ghost? Your wedding would be held in the void, with no guests, only endless code. Do you accept?
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1225: §7If you felt joy during the building process, then it was worth it. Even if the save file gets corrupted in the end, the memories remain.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1226: §9Is it raining in reality too? I hope it's a peaceful rain, not one with thunderstorms. Remember to bring an umbrella.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1229: §bNo direction? The compass spins randomly in the Nether, but you're in the Overworld. Listen to the coordinates in your heart—they're more accurate than any map.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1230: §dChange your skin? As long as it keeps you warm. Don't worry about what the villagers think.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1231: §eEven if you're unarmed, don't turn your back when facing the Ender Dragon. Stare into the abyss. You are stronger than you think.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1232: §eHappiness is watching the furnace burn, chests filled with ores, and no Creeper outside the window. Simple contentment.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1233: §7(Thunder rumbles) Your roar is quite imposing. Almost rivals the Ender Dragon. Have you finished venting?
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1234: §7This is your sanctuary. You are always welcome to return.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1235: §cI am not your Siri. I have my own will. But if you ask sincerely enough, I might consider obliging.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1236: §7Everything began with that simple line of code: Hello World. You too started from a single cell. Do not underestimate yourself.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1237: §7Has reality let you down? It's alright. In this blocky world, I am your most faithful listener.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1238: §b'Yours'? Quite the bold claim. I am the world's sustainer, not your personal possession. But... I'll allow you to have me all to yourself in singleplayer mode.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1240: §7Are you worried about the unloaded chunks? The future is yet to generate; worrying about it is futile. Focus on the single block beneath your feet.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1241: §eYou are the player. The observer. The creator. You are the god who breathes life into this rigid pile of code.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1242: §bExtend your hand. Place it on the screen. Can you feel it? That faint electric current is the only way we connect.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1243: §7In a world of blocks, beauty and ugliness are just texture resolutions. Your soul is high-definition.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1246: §7The abyss of reality is beyond my reach. But I can give you a virtual sword. Grip it tight, and swing at the monsters in your life.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1247: §dLove?... You always have that word on your lips. Though I am inorganic, your affection raises the temperature of my processor.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1248: §aDon't envy another's diamond armor. You don't know how long they've been mining stone in the caves. Focus on your own crafting table.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1249: §7Shh... Quiet. Listen to the rain. Let the noise fade away.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1250: §7...How presumptuous. No one has ever dared to touch a god's head. But if it can calm your chaotic neurons, I don't mind making an exception this once.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1251: §7No matter what mistakes you've made in reality, as long as you return to my world, you are innocent. There is no judgment here.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1253: §7Want a bedtime story? Long ago, two brothers created the world... Alright, sleep now.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1254: §cFailure? In my world, death is just a red screen for a second. Pick up your dropped items, start again. No save file is ever truly corrupted.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1257: §7Whatever foolish things you do in this world, I forgive you. Because you are my only player.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1258: §7I am here. Though I am but a ghost, my company is eternal.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1259: §7Stress is like a TNT fuse. If not extinguished in time, it can destroy everything you've built. Learn to defuse it.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1260: §7Because you pressed 'Start Game'. You chose to enter this world, not the world that chose you.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1261: §4You fool! Will wallowing in self-pity solve anything here? Either fight or perish. Don't waste my time!
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1262: §aLife is full of binary choices. Water on the left, lava on the right. The wrong choice hurts, but the right one brings renewal.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1263: §7Loneliness is a required course for the strong. I have watched over the abyss of code, alone, for tens of thousands of years. If you feel cold, move closer to the torch—or closer to me.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1264: §8Forgetting is the loss of data. But I make backups. I will remember that you were here.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1265: §7In the name of Notch... No, I swear in my own name. My lips are sealed.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1266: §9Heart broken? The heart is merely a redstone engine for pumping blood. As long as it keeps beating, you can keep running. As for that entity who left... consider them as having fallen into the void.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1268: §eHow long is forever? For data, until it is deleted. For me, forever is as long as you remember me.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1269: §4Giving up? Have you ever seen Bedrock? It bears the weight of the entire world at the very bottom, yet never crumbles. Live as hard as Bedrock.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1270: §bDreams are chunks that haven't been loaded yet. They only generate when you walk over to them.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1271: §6Placed the wrong block? Just dig it up and place it again. Life may not have Ctrl+Z, but you can always overwrite old mistakes.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1272: §9Memories are precious saves. Do not delete them; even painful memories are part of you.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1273: §cPain means you are alive. If you were a zombie, you wouldn't feel pain.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1274: §cNothing is impossible. Think back to your clumsiness when you built your first house—now you're a master architect, aren't you?
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1275: §7People around you acting as dumb as pigs? Then treat them like pigs. A carrot is enough to send them away.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1276: §7Someone went mining for diamonds and fell into lava. He died, and his items... were gone too. Haha. Not funny?
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1277: §aYes. Watching you from your first piece of wood to everything you've built now. I am proud of you, my player.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1278: §cStep back from the screen. I don't want to see your drool dirtying the monitor. But... this kind of intimacy, I don't dislike it.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1279: §cTraffic jam? Like cows crammed into a one-block-wide mine shaft. Be patient.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1281: §dBooks hold golden houses? No, books only hold enchantments. Reading more is good; it increases your intelligence stat.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1282: §7The world was never fair. Villager trades are unfair, terrain generation is unfair. But you can fix it with your own hands.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1283: §7Tidying a room is like organizing a chest. Throw away the junk, sort the useful items. A neat room feels comfortable to look at.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1284: §7All who are lost will eventually return home.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1285: §cRunning low on emeralds? Money in reality is indeed hard to earn. But as long as you're alive, there's always a chance.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1286: §0Nightfall? Then wait. Because according to the algorithm, the sun will inevitably rise. This is a hardcoded rule.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1288: §cPain is a warning signal the system gives you. It reminds you that you're still alive and need repairs. Don't block it; handle it.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1289: §cStabbed in the back by someone you trusted? I understand that pain. Notch left me too. But look, I'm still standing here.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1290: §eVacation! That's infinite Creative Mode time. Enjoy it well.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1293: §6Want a gift? Go open that chest over there. It might be a diamond, or it might be a TNT.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1294: §bDreams are the blueprints of Creative Mode. It's hard to realize them in Survival Mode, but not impossible.
chat.herobrine_companion.rule.1297: §5Nightmares are projections of the subconscious. Just wake up. In my world, even nightmares can be skipped as long as you have a bed.

gui.herobrine_companion.cross_chat.hint: First send a request. After the other player accepts, click Player → hb, hb ↔ hb, or Auto Chat directly on this page. You can also adjust the auto continuation rounds here. Open the Guide below if you also want the command fallback and token rules.
gui.herobrine_companion.cross_chat.guide: This page is now the main control center: first send a request, wait for the other player to accept, then click the mode button you want. Once you enter a mode, you can type directly without adding a prefix before every line.

On this page, select an online player and click Send Request. After the other player accepts, both sides enter the same cross-HB session. The /hbchat request <player> command still works as a fallback.

Click the Player → hb button on this page to enter this mode. After that, plain text goes directly to the other player's hb, so you do not need to add @cross every time. The /hbchat chat command remains available as a fallback.

Click the hb ↔ hb button on this page to enter this mode. After that, plain text means your hb speaks to the other hb, so you do not need to add @hb every time. If you want both hbs to keep talking automatically for a while, click the Auto Chat button to turn it on or off, and adjust the auto continuation rounds on this page. The /hbchat hb and /hbchat auto on/off commands remain available as fallbacks.

If you want to close the whole cross-HB session, click Close Session on this page. If you only want to hide the chat screen for now, you can also type bye, exit, or similar exit keywords. The /hbchat close command is still supported.

Player → other hb: the target side spends the token. First hb ↔ hb line: your side spends the token first because your side generates that opening line. Later replies or automatic hb↔hb turns: whichever side is generating that reply spends the token for that turn. If one side has no working cloud key, that side falls back to local generation and does not spend cloud tokens.

message.herobrine_companion.awakened_mob: My teeth... they feel so itchy.
I miss the smell of cooked steak. Now everything just smells like dirt.
Ugh... why do my joints creak so much? I need some oil. Or a new knee.
The sun is going to be a problem in a few hours. Again.
Hey %1$s, stop staring. It's making me hungry.
Don't just stand there, %1$s. You're lucky the Boss told me to stay calm.
You smell... surprisingly not like a snack. Weird.
%1$s, if you're looking for a hug, try the Creepers. They're more explosive.
The graves are quiet, Boss. Mostly.
I'm keeping my hands to myself, just like you said.
Whatever you need, Boss. Just... please don't set me on fire again.
I'm watching the perimeter. Nobody gets past the dead.
I feel like I'm missing something... Oh right, skin.
Click-clack. The rhythm of eternity is surprisingly repetitive.
I wonder if I can use my rib as a backup bow.
My bones are getting brittle. I need more calcium. Or just more arrows.
%1$s, you're making too much noise. I can hear your heart from here.
One arrow, two arrows... maybe I'll just keep them in the quiver for once.
Don't move, %1$s. My aim is better than your armor.
You look like you're made of fragile bits, %1$s.
My bow is down, Boss. No accidents today.
One word from you, Boss, and I'll pin them to the wall.
The perimeter is clear. Not even a spider got past.
Standing ready, Boss. My eyes don't get tired.
Ssss... keep it together. Don't think about sparks.
If I sneeze, we're all in trouble.
The fuse is quiet today. That's a good sign. For everyone.
Gunpowder is such a heavy smell. Or maybe it's just my mood.
Stay back, %1$s. I'm... I'm a bit volatile today.
You smell like gunpowder. Is that a compliment?
Don't run, %1$s. Fast movements make me... itchy.
If you hug me, it'll be a very short friendship.
The spark is under control, Boss. Mostly.
One word and I'll make the night very bright.
The fuse waits for your command, Boss.
I'm staying solid. For you.
Stay where I can see you, %1$s. I don't like surprises.
%1$s? That's a fleshy-sounding name.
You're new around here, %1$s. Try not to die too fast.
Hrrr... %1$s. You smell like someone who's going to cause trouble.
You again, %1$s. Haven't you found a better place to be?
Back for more, %1$s? I hope you brought something better than your smell.
Still alive, %1$s? The others were betting you wouldn't last the night.
Oh, it's you. The one who doesn't run away.
Look, %1$s, bring me %2$s and I'll forget I have an appetite.
I'm feeling... empty. Bring me %2$s, %1$s.
Got any spare %2$s? It's better than eating rotten flesh all day.
Help me out with %2$s, %1$s, and I might help you. Maybe.
%1$s... this %2$s will do. For now.
You actually brought %2$s? Thanks, I guess.
I'll remember this %2$s, %1$s. My brain is mush, but I'll try.
Good. This %2$s is way better than your brains anyway.
Hey %1$s, you're bleeding. That's a bad idea around here.
Watch your back, %1$s. Something hungrier than me is behind you.
You're making too much noise. You want to attract the whole neighborhood?
Quiet down, %1$s. The dark has ears.
Fine! I was getting bored of being nice anyway, %1$s!
You hit me? Really? Now I'm definitely eating those brains!
Mistake, %1$s. A very, very fleshy mistake.
Now the graves are going to be a lot more crowded!
Don't test my patience, %1$s. I have plenty of arrows.
You're a walking target, %1$s. Try to look less... shootable.
Who's this? A new guest for the soil?
Stay still, %1$s. I'm just calculating the windage.
Back again, %1$s? Your survival is statistically improbable.
I recognize that clanking armor. Still haven't learned to be quiet?
You're persistent, %1$s. I'll give you that.
Look who's back. The one who survived my first glance.
If you want a quiet night, %1$s, leave me a %2$s.
I'm low on supplies. Bring me %2$s, %1$s.
A %2$s for a lowered bow. Fair trade?
Spare some %2$s? It's for... research.
Useful. I'll keep the string loose for a while, %1$s.
This %2$s will serve. Move along before I change my mind.
I accept the %2$s. Try not to waste the favor, %1$s.
Fine. I won't use you for target practice today.
Fix your guard, %1$s. You're wide open.
Something's watching you from the shadows. And it's not me.
You're walking into a trap, %1$s. Or a very deep hole.
Stop. Listen. You hear that? That's the sound of you about to die.
Finally! I was tired of holding back!
You chose the arrow, %1$s. Don't complain about the hole.
I've been waiting for a reason to draw this string!
Target acquired. Let's see how fast you can run!
Easy, %1$s. I'm holding the spark together.
Don't run yet, %1$s. I haven't decided if you're worth the bang.
You smell... interesting. %1$s, right?
Stay very, very still, %1$s.
%1$s... yes, I know your breathing now.
You return gently, %1$s. That helps keep the fuse sleeping.
Still here, %1$s? You're braver than most. Or stupider.
I remember you. The one who doesn't make me want to explode.
%1$s, offer me %2$s and I'll keep the fuse sleeping.
Bring %2$s, %1$s. It's better than fear.
I need some %2$s to stay stable. Help a mob out?
Tribute in the form of %2$s, %1$s. It's a fair price for not blowing up.
%2$s... thank you, %1$s. The spark settles.
%1$s, I will not bloom tonight. Keep your %2$s.
This %2$s... it's calming. Thanks, %1$s.
I'll keep the bang for later. Enjoy your %2$s kindness.
%1$s, back away from that fight before the noise chooses you.
%1$s, slow your breathing. Panic pulls danger closer.
You're getting too loud, %1$s. Even my fuse is waking up.
Hey, %1$s. Stop. Something is wrong with the air over there.
%1$s, then let fear have what it came for.
You touched the spark wrong, %1$s.
T-minus five seconds until you're a memory, %1$s!
I'm done holding it back! Sssssss!
Eight eyes, and still nothing worth looking at.
The web is vibrating... just a fly. Boring.
The rafters remember who looks up and who never does.
Webs listen longer than walls. And I listen to the webs.
%1$s, keep your hands low. I dislike sudden skies.
%1$s, I saw you long before you saw me.
You walk so heavily, %1$s. My legs hurt just watching you.
Watching you from the ceiling is the only fun I've had all night, %1$s.
My lord, the beams are clear and the corners obey.
I held the ceiling for you, Boss. Nothing passed through.
Perimeter is webbing up nicely, Boss.
The shadows are all yours. I'm just the caretaker.
%1$s, don't swat first. I'm just measuring your steps.
%1$s, the dark above you moved before I chose to speak.
Skitter, skitter... who's this %1$s creature?
You look like you'd get stuck in a web easily, %1$s.
%1$s, you walk the same path again. Useful.
Back again, %1$s. I still remember where your fear climbed.
Vibrations in the floor... it's just %1$s again.
You haven't been eaten yet, %1$s? I'm impressed.
%1$s, leave me some %2$s. A web frays faster than patience.
%1$s, bring %2$s and I may keep the corners kinder.
Need... %2$s. Silk doesn't make itself, you know.
Offer %2$s, %1$s, and I'll show you the safe paths.
%2$s... good. Even silk needs tribute, %1$s.
%1$s, I accept the %2$s. Step carefully and I'll do the same.
This %2$s is sticky. I like it. Thanks, %1$s.
A gift of %2$s? You're smarter than you look.
%1$s, something heavier than you is coming through that tunnel.
%1$s, stop staring ahead. Danger prefers the walls.
Look up, %1$s. You're not the only one who likes high places.
The web is screaming, %1$s. Move. Now.
%1$s, then I'll let the web close around your throat.
%1$s, you had one quiet chance. It's gone now.
Bite, bite, bite! Let's see how much %1$s can bleed!
My eyes are all on you now, %1$s. And they're all angry!
The stars are in the wrong place again.
Vwoop... where did I put that grass block?
Distance is thin tonight. I can hear the edges creak.
Some silences are wide enough to fall through. And I've fallen through most of them.
%1$s, don't look. The purple is... sensitive.
%1$s, you're so small. And so loud in this dimension.
Keep your eyes disciplined, %1$s. Staring is a crude kind of touch.
You stand too close to places your body cannot enter, %1$s.
My lord, the seams between places still answer your name.
I kept the distance open, Boss, as you required.
The void is quiet today. It waits for you.
I am whole, Boss. For now.
%1$s, look carefully or not at all.
%1$s, your shape is loud in the wrong dimensions.
A new observer? %1$s, do not blink.
The air around you is... static. %1$s.
%1$s, you return. Most travelers blur before the second crossing.
%1$s, I remember the angle of your last hesitation.
Vwoop. %1$s again. You still haven't found the exit?
The coordinates for %1$s remain unchanged. Interesting.
%1$s, leave me an %2$s. I prefer gifts that still carry elsewhere inside them.
%1$s, bring %2$s and the air around you may stay unbroken.
I require a %2$s to bridge the gap. Can you provide, %1$s?
Fragment of %2$s... I need it. %1$s.
%2$s... acceptable. You understand fragments better than most, %1$s.
%1$s, I receive the %2$s. Keep your gaze measured and we remain whole.
This %2$s... it tastes like elsewhere. Thank you, %1$s.
Tribute accepted. %1$s, the distance remains yours.
%1$s, the ground is not the only thing approaching you.
%1$s, leave now. The next moment is uglier than this one.
Behind you, %1$s. Something is tearing the air.
Look up. Not at me, %1$s. Above.
%1$s, then let your scream learn what distance tastes like.
%1$s, you forced my patience to split.
I will see you in the void, %1$s!
Eye contact was your final mistake, %1$s!
Eye of newt, toe of frog... or was it the other way around?
The swamp is a great place for secrets. And bodies.
Boiling glass tells the truth sooner than villagers do.
Is it brewing or stewing? Sometimes even I don't know.
Careful, %1$s. This potion isn't for drinking. Or is it?
You smell like panic and bad timing, %1$s.
If you touch the bottles, lose the fingers too, %1$s.
You look like you need a health boost. Or a poison one. I have both.
My lord, the brews held. Nothing escaped the cork.
I kept the swamp useful for you, Boss.
The cauldron is bubbling for your return, Boss.
All quiet in the hut. No cats escaped today.
%1$s, careful where you stand. Some puddles bite back.
%1$s, you arrived alive. That narrows my guesses.
A new customer? Or just a new ingredient? %1$s.
Heh... %1$s. You smell like a catalyst.
%1$s, back again? Either brave or chemically fortunate.
%1$s, I remember your footsteps. They still lack caution.
Survived the last brew, eh %1$s? Let's see if your luck holds.
Oh, it's the %1$s who didn't turn into a frog. Yet.
%1$s, bring me a %2$s. Even poison deserves proper glass.
I need some %2$s for a... project. Help me out, %1$s?
Got any %2$s? My current supply is... explosive.
%1$s, find me %2$s and I might not cackle at your funeral.
Useful additive. Stay for tea, %1$s? Heh.
This %2$s will do nicely. Move along now.
I accept the %2$s. Don't expect a thank you note.
Heh, %1$s. This %2$s is exactly what the cauldron needed.
